publisher: Microsoft Corporation, FCC submission; obtained from FCCID.io mirror
download_method: Direct NETWORK_INTERFACE with proxy disabled, fccid.io resolved to 172.66.43.93 using HTTPS AliDNS at 223.5.5.5. Followed inspected same-host 302 Location explicitly.

validation.rendering: pdftoppm -scale-to 700 -jpeg; small page previews only, original retained unchanged

observations.finding: Two uncapped stick modules mounted on the same PCB, with metal frames and side potentiometer housings. Page 7 includes two perpendicular rulers.
observations.use: Candidate for checking stick-center layout and module outline against visual assets. Manufacturer part number and pivot height are not legible in inspected previews.
observations.caution: Rulers and raised components are not necessarily coplanar. A scalar pixel-to-mm conversion is not a calibrated 3D measurement.

observations.finding: Front PCB exposes button contact patterns, two stick apertures and shoulder switch components; rulers are visible.
observations.use: Cross-check control topology and relative planar placement, not button travel or force.

observations.finding: Rear assembly view includes large handle vibration motors and both rear trigger assemblies.
observations.use: Assembly correspondence reference. This view does not establish a dimensioned trigger hinge or force law.

next_geometry_harness: Annotate independent ruler marks and PCB landmarks at original resolution, fit image calibration with held-out residuals, account for plane offset/perspective, and compare left/right stick spacing to the existing width-scaled proxy. Do not promote a single-view fit to calibrated 3D axes.
reuse: Reference evidence only. Public FCC disclosure is not treated as an open-source CAD license.
